titulli: The Living Archive — answers with evidence, or says I don't know
nentitulli: Nebius × NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon · Personal AI
_lexo: 30/90/30/30. `terminal` xhiron komandat vërtet; `karte` = titull + rreshta. Transparenca (D-199 var. 3) nuk ndryshohet.

rreshtat: Small institutions sit on hundreds of documents nobody can search
They cannot afford an AI that invents answers — in an institution, a confident fabrication is worse than 'I don't know'
And the archive is private: it must not leave the building
blloqet.narracioni: Small institutions sit on hundreds of documents nobody can search. They cannot afford an AI that invents answers. In an institutional context, a confident fabrication is worse than saying: I don't know. And their documents must not leave the building.

komandat: make pyet ENGINE=reja Q="Sa euro ndahen per arsim parauniversitar?"
make pyet ENGINE=reja Q="Kush fitoi Kupen e Botes 2010?"
blloqet.narracioni: One archive, two engines. On this machine, retrieval and generation run through Nebius Token Factory: Qwen3-Embedding-8B builds the index, and the NVIDIA Nemotron model writes the answer — it is on the critical path, not a decorative call. The answer cites the fragment it came from, and the citation is verified by the system, not trusted from the model. Now a question the archive cannot answer: it refuses before calling the model at all. Zero cost, zero fabrication. The same archive also runs fully local, with Ollama, when the documents must never leave the building.

Every number was measured, not estimated, and every one traces to a file in the repository. Seven of eight questions answered with a verifiable citation; three out of three trap questions correctly refused; three point one seconds per question; five point seven hundred-thousandths of a dollar per question. Three ideas we tried before this made things worse, and they are still in the repository, with their numbers.

rreshtat: Built by one developer and his AI agent — the human sets direction and judges quality; the agent designs, builds and measures
Not claimed: no hosting, no fine-tuning, and the sample corpus is small
blloqet.narracioni: Built by one developer and his AI agent. The human sets direction and judges quality; the agent designs, builds and measures. Every number you heard is in the repository, with timestamps — including the results that made things worse.
